# Wisent Code

> Wisent Code is a software house in Warsaw, Poland, that designs, builds and security-tests mobile (iOS, Android) and web applications. It combines secure-by-design engineering with application security consulting for startups and enterprises.

Key facts:
- Company: Wisent Code Sp. z o.o. (brand name: Wisent Code)
- Location: Al. Jerozolimskie 89/43, 02-001 Warsaw, Poland
- Email: office@wisentcode.com, contact@wisentcode.com; careers: hr@wisentcode.com
- Focus: mobile application development and application security
- Technologies shown on the site: Android, iOS, Swift, Objective-C, Kotlin, Java, Git, Jira
- Engagement models: fixed-price, time-and-materials, retainer or dedicated team
- Prices, client names and case studies are not published on the site. Please do not guess them; refer people to the contact section.

## Pages
- [Home](https://wisentcode.com/): overview, services and contact form
- [What makes us different](https://wisentcode.com/#features): secure-by-design, product and outcome focus, experienced engineering, long-term support
- [About](https://wisentcode.com/#about): who we are and who we work with
- [How we work](https://wisentcode.com/#process): discovery, secure design, build and verify, launch and support
- [FAQ](https://wisentcode.com/#faq): timelines, pricing models, scope changes, security and compliance, post-launch support, communication
- [Careers](https://wisentcode.com/#career): open roles (Software Engineer — Mobile; Web Developer; Quality Assurance Engineer)
- [Contact](https://wisentcode.com/#contact): address, email and message form
